Face three-quarter LEFT like reference. Match original head-to-body ratio and body size throughout. All feet on same relative baseline per cell. Entire character and weapon contained in central 75% of EACH cell, wide transparent gutters, no touching or overlap between cells. No glow, no sword trail, no particles, no shadows, no background, no labels, no grid. Square overall image.
